name: Tunisia

fees.name: Tunisia sticker visa - single entry
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa, applying via Tunisian Embassy (Washington DC)
fees.notes: Fee published by the Tunisian Embassy in the United States; fee applies to tourist, business, and transit visa types per the embassy page. Fees may differ at other Tunisian embassies/consulates worldwide - this is not a universal fee schedule. Payment by money order only; fees non-refundable.

fees.name: Tunisia sticker visa - multiple entry
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa, applying via Tunisian Embassy (Washington DC)
fees.notes: Fee published by the Tunisian Embassy in the United States. Fees may differ at other Tunisian embassies/consulates worldwide.

fees.name: Tunisia business visa
fees.notes: Embassy page states current visa fees ($90 single entry / $180 multiple entries) apply to all visa types including business, but does not itemize a separate business-visa fee. Could not verify a distinct official amount.

fees.name: Tunisia transit visa
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa for transit
fees.notes: Embassy page states fees apply for all visa types (tourist/business/transit) at $90/$180, but does not itemize transit separately. Amount not independently verified from an official transit-specific schedule.

fees.name: Tunisia e-Visa
fees.applies: eligible nationalities not on Tunisia's visa-exempt list
fees.notes: Tunisia launched an e-visa platform (evisa.tn) following a 2024 international tender for a short-stay single-entry tourism e-visa (processed in ~3 working days). Could not verify the official fee amount: evisa.tn returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch and no independent official source confirmed a specific fee figure as of 2026-07-02. Do not treat as free - amount is unverified, not zero.

free_visa_notes: Tunisia has a visa-exempt list for many nationalities (e.g. most EU, US territories arrangements vary); this record covers fees only for nationalities that require a visa. No universal free-visa regime exists for all travellers.
